title: Thunder Substack (by Andreea Popa): If your own story doesn't inspire you, it's time to change it
summary: Andreea Popa writes about a line Cris Pop shared with her that changed her mindset: "If your own story doesn't inspire you, it's time to change it." She argues that the narratives we hold about ourselves shape our choices, that one miss shouldn't define us, and she offers reflection questions for rewriting the next chapter.

principles.text: If your own story doesn't inspire you, change it. This is the line the author credits to Cris.
principles.quote: “If your own story doesn’t inspire you, it’s time to change it.”

principles.text: Your story isn't set in stone; you have the power and the responsibility to rewrite the next chapter.
principles.quote: But stories can evolve. And if the current chapter feels uninspiring, you have the power and the responsibility to rewrite the next one.

principles.text: Don't let one missed shot define the whole match; we dwell on misses and forget the wins.
principles.quote: We replay the misses and downplay the wins. We carry the weight of a single moment as if it defines the whole match.

principles.text: Check whether you follow your own path or other people's expectations.
principles.quote: Am I following my own path or what others expect?

principles.text: An uninspiring chapter isn't failure; it signals readiness for growth.
principles.quote: It means you're ready for growth.
